agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted boolean condition in boltons/urlutils.py URL.get_authority(): changed `if not (self.password):` to `if self.password:` so the password is correctly appended to the userinfo part of the authority string when present and omitted when absent. This resolves the roundtrip/userinfo/quoted-userinfo regression. Verified via manual script: URL('http://wiki:pa$$a@hatnote.com').to_text() now round-trips correctly, and URL('http://wiki@hatnote.com').to_text() correctly omits the password.
